review_policy: A repository listed here is not an approval to copy or bundle it. license_status=plan-recorded is a master-plan claim, not a verified license grant; license_status=absent means no verified license file/grant and permits concepts only. approved/imported require a present license, a recorded revision and owner review.

dependencies.permitted_use: Read for agent/session cards, meeting UI and session grouping concepts.
dependencies.prohibited_use: No code, asset or bundle reuse without a verified license. Process visibility is not durable state or authorization.

dependencies.prohibited_use: No code or asset reuse without a verified license. Do not infer runtime or persistence it does not prove.
